paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values for a vanilla Transformer model and a SepLLM model over a range of FLOPs. The x-axis, labeled “FLOPs,” represents the number of floating-point operations, utilizing a logarithmic scale with a tick interval of 1e9, ranging from approximately 0 to 1.25e9. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” indicates the loss value, measured on a linear scale beginning at 0.00 and extending to approximately 4.30, with tick intervals of 0.01. The purple line represents the vanilla Transformer model, which begins at a loss value of approximately 2.73 and decreases to a value of approximately 2.50 throughout the x-axis. The red line represents the SepLLM model, which begins at a loss value of approximately 2.45 and decreases to a value of approximately 2.40 throughout the x-axis.
